 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep=next(r for r,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg)
    sepcolor=g[sep][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r,c) in seen or g[r][c] in (bg,sepcolor): continue
            color=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append(comp)
    comp=max(comps,key=len)
    top=min(r for r,c in comp); bottom=max(r for r,c in comp)
    if bottom<sep:
        dr=sep-1-bottom
    else:
        dr=sep+1-top
    for r,c in comp: g[r][c]=bg
    for r,c in comp: g[r+dr][c]=grid[r][c]
    movedtop=top+dr; movedbottom=bottom+dr
    marker=movedtop-1 if bottom<sep else movedbottom+1
    if 0<=marker<h: g[marker]=[8]*w
    return g
